title: WIP: OCPNODE-2018: Vendor OCI Referrers API support and add system tests
body:
WIP PR to get CI feedback on the OCI Referrers API integration.

Vendors the container-libs image library changes from containers/container-libs#1111 that add OCI Referrers API support for signature discovery and writing. Adds BATS system tests that verify referrers-based signature discovery works end-to-end during image copy operations.

The go.mod uses a local path replace directive for now. This will be updated to the final upstream version once containers/container-libs#1111 is merged.

**Do not merge.** This is a WIP PR for CI feedback only.
